title: OntoSTL Transforms Signal Temporal Logic Formulas Into Knowledge Graphs
summary: OntoSTL transforms Signal Temporal Logic requirements into OWL knowledge graphs and applies canonicalization rules to reduce structural redundancy.

title: New Framework Generates Executable Suggestions for MDE
summary: The gamma mu S framework combines Large Language Models with rule-based verification to produce well-formed modeling suggestions.

title: Pattern-Based Approach Validates SysML v2 Models
summary: Researchers introduced an approach using the Refinery graph solver to detect undesired patterns and validate SysML v2 models.

title: ModelsOrbit Addresses Model-Driven Engineering for Satellite Fleets
summary: ModelsOrbit introduces model-driven engineering foundations to govern evolving satellite fleets operating under partial knowledge and communication constraints.

title: Automated Generation of Vehicle Security Models from Threat Intelligence
summary: A new prototype automatically transforms public cyber threat intelligence from MITRE ATT&CK into valid security model instances.

title: Physical Execution Plans Decouple DSL Design from Runtime
summary: A proposed approach for Model-Driven Engineering introduces physical execution plans to separate model meaning from runtime-specific representations.

title: ALBATROSS Hybrid Robot Sails and Flies
summary: Researchers developed a hybrid aerial-marine robot that autorotates to water and uses its wings for wind-powered navigation.

title: Aston Martin Unveils DBX GT
summary: Aston Martin introduced the DBX GT luxury SUV featuring 717 horsepower.

title: MIT Students Publish Space Economy Guide
summary: An MIT aerospace entrepreneurship class released an industry report providing guidance for aspiring space leaders and investors.

title: Caterpillar Plans $1B North Carolina Expansion
summary: Caterpillar is investing $1 billion to expand its Sanford, North Carolina manufacturing plant with a new facility.

title: Wearable Systems Driven by Health Monitoring
summary: Device miniaturization is driving higher performance and quality in smaller form factors for continuous health monitoring.

title: Dynatrace Completes Acquisition of AI Platform Arize
summary: Dynatrace has completed its acquisition of Arize, an AI platform whose capabilities will be gradually integrated into the Dynatrace platform.

title: Sabel and Anark Partner for Model-Based Defense Reviews
summary: TDPWerx will validate full CAD baselines and support 3Di PDF and HTML technical data package formats through a new partnership.

title: Chip Industry Week In Review: CFETs, AI, and Photonics
summary: Recent developments include CFET scaling past 10 angstroms, AI investments in power and packaging, and advances in quantum hardware.

title: Synopsys and OpenAI Partner for EDA Tool AI Models
summary: Synopsys and OpenAI will jointly develop GPT-Synopsys to optimize semiconductor design workflows using EDA tools.

title: Imec Launches NeuroIGNITOR for Living Tissue Stimulation
summary: Imec introduced NeuroIGNITOR, a selective bidirectional platform enabling researchers to design and test stimulation paradigms in living tissue.

title: SV Microwave Introduces Mini-D RF Interconnects
summary: SV Microwave launched SMPM Mini-D RF Interconnects in a space-saving D-sub form factor for board-to-board RF applications.

title: Aliner Debuts Lightweight Alite A-Frame Trailer
summary: The Alite towable A-frame trailer weighs under 700 pounds, sets up in 30 seconds, and offers a hard-walled micro-hut.

title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Researchers proposed FERPO, a new on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement without differentiating the critic with respect to actions.

title: InterEvolve Enables Test-Time Evolution for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: InterEvolve uses a behavioral foundation model and an LLM agent to evolve reward programs at test time, enabling physical humanoid robots to adapt to new tasks.

title: Minimal Experiments for Robust Data-Driven Stabilization
summary: Researchers analyzed the shortest input sequences required to support robust data-driven stabilization across linear systems.

title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Zero-Shot Coordination via Partner Constraints
summary: A new framework enables a robot helper to infer a partner robot's physical constraints from observed joint behavior and coordinate on new tasks.

title: DuoMind Framework Enhances Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination
summary: DuoMind combines vision-language models and action models in a distributed framework to improve multi-robot coordination and execution.

title: Control Barrier Function Governor for Simultaneous Input-Output Constraints
summary: Researchers derived necessary and sufficient conditions for a control barrier function-based governor to satisfy simultaneous input and output constraints in LTI systems.

title: SkeleWAM Introduces Sparse 3D Skeletons for Robotic Manipulation
summary: SkeleWAM uses sparse 3D skeletons constructed from RGB-D observations to provide an efficient state space for robotic action generation and future state prediction.

title: Decentralized Power-Optimal Coordination for Magnetically Actuated Spacecraft
summary: A new decentralized framework uses time-varying magnetorquer actuation to achieve power-optimal coordination for large spacecraft swarms.

title: Binary Phase Retrieval of Cosine Transforms via Curvature Minimization
summary: Researchers developed an algorithm to solve binary phase retrieval for optical cosine transforms by minimizing the curvature of the reconstructed transform.

title: Qualcomm Debuts Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoCs
summary: Qualcomm introduced two new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoCs for smartphones to expand personal agentic AI.

title: HumanoidToolBench Evaluates Humanoid Tool Use
summary: HumanoidToolBench is a new 18-task benchmark and dataset designed to evaluate humanoids on selecting tools and executing tasks across simulation and real hardware.

title: Auditing Airway Flow Operator Composition
summary: Researchers audit zero-shot composition of local airway flow operators and find that local regularization fails to guarantee accurate global fields or conservation.
